description.content: WeTravel Partner API — Trip Builder, Bookings/Orders, Payments (payment links), Transactions, Suppliers and Leads. Harvested from the WeTravel Developer Hub per-endpoint OpenAPI fragments (developer.wetravel.com). Paths normalized to the https://api.wetravel.com/v2 base.
